rationale: Zone 1 set to 81.5% of protected line impedance (26.39 Ω) for underreach. Zone 2 covers protected line plus 55% of shortest backup line (L_BC). Zone 3 covers protected line plus 110% of longest backup line (L_BD) while remaining well below load-encroachment limit (121 Ω). Reaches strictly increasing; delays nondecreasing and within coordination windows.
